label: MONEY STORY
hook: Arjun got a ₹20,000 festival bonus. Here's what he did.

slides.text: Arjun's first thought was a shiny new phone.
Then he remembered last year's bonus: gone in two weeks, nothing to show.
So he split it before spending a rupee.
He still enjoyed the festival, and his emergency fund grew without stress.
Lesson: decide where a bonus goes before it reaches your wallet.
Try this today: write a 3-way split for your next bonus or extra income.
